market_view: Calm regime: VIX 15.6 and falling, 10-year yield 4.48%, dollar firm near 100.9. Oil is the live story, with a Hormuz tanker attack and a US sanctions-waiver revocation pushing crude up after the last close in the record.

oil_gas.catalyst: "Oil prices jump 5% after U.S. revokes Iran oil sanctions waiver following ship attacks" (NBC News); "Exxon signals Q2 profit windfall as higher oil prices boost bottom line" (Reuters)
oil_gas.reasoning: Supply-shock headlines landed after the last close; WTI is down 26% in 20 days and XOM down 10%, so little of the rebound is in the stock yet. XOM has Q2 earnings coming in the window. Risk: the headlines may fade and the open may gap up.

gold_miners.reasoning: Only commentary headlines (Morningstar says gold has entered a bear market, a Seeking Alpha NEM opinion piece). Gold is down 7% in 20 days with a firm dollar and rising yields. No one-sided scheduled event.

chips.reasoning: The only NVDA headline is a blog post on nations deploying AI, which is not a catalyst. The sector ETF is up 43% in 60 days. No export-rule or earnings event named.

pharma.reasoning: The pharma headline is about a veterinary device, unrelated to LLY. No trial, approval or pricing news. LLY is near its high and fell 1.1% on the last day with the sector.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Headlines are a local uranium mine protest, a small copper explorer's stake and a Cameco listicle. None concern FCX or move copper supply. The copper driver is mixed.

would_change_my_mind: For XOM: crude fully reversing the jump or a de-escalation report; for others: a named company or supply event for the leader stock.

handoff.what_changed: Oil headlines turned: tanker attacks in Hormuz, the US revoked the Iran sanctions waiver, crude jumped 4-5% and Exxon signalled a Q2 profit windfall. Went long XOM as the only catalyst-backed call. Gold miners flagged as in a bear market; no news on Cameco restart or Newmont call date in this record.

oil_gas.why: Iran supply-shock headlines plus Exxon Q2 windfall signal, after a 26% crude slide.

gold_miners.why: Gold in a bear market, firm dollar and yields, no company catalyst for NEM.

chips.why: No named catalyst for NVDA; sector already up sharply.

copper_uranium.why: No headline concerns FCX; copper driver mixed.
